scientific_integrity: All infinite-dimensional conclusions are proved from the exact beta-law diagonalization, gamma weak limit, simplex counting and dominated convergence. The checker supplies finite supplementary tests only. The claimed novelty is provisional against historical literature.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the lift-total-degree filtration and product-coordinate radial cutoffs on canonical weighted symmetrized-polydisc Bergman spaces, for fixed dimension, weight and collar parameter. No general nonradial cutoff claim, uniform joint N/collar limit, or independent mathematical audit is asserted.
title: A gamma-convolution spectral law for shrinking product collars on symmetrized polydiscs
